name: APOZi Collection 'Ink Poet' Unisex British Style Long Trench Coat
description: Step into a world of poetic, literary sophistication with this exquisite piece from APOZi Collection's 'Ink Poet' (墨痕诗人) series. Originally purchased on Taobao, this unisex British-style mid-long trench coat beautifully merges classic western tailoring with modern Eastern aesthetic charm. Crafted from a high-quality, breathable cotton-linen blend fabric with a rich tactile crinkle texture, it features a fluid, relaxed silhouette that drapes effortlessly over any frame. Designed with a stylish high-stand buttoned collar, classic flap pockets, and an adjustable waist tie-belt to cinch your look. Please note: This comes from a pet-friendly home with a cat. The trench coat has been freshly laundered, deeply sanitized, and meticulously lint-rolled. It is in fantastic clean condition with zero rips or tears—an absolute dream piece for anyone who appreciates unique indie designer fashion!
